\section[il conto corrente]{il conto corrente — a bank account}

\label{lesson:IT-C253-conto-corrente}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Italian for a lie, then the Italian for a secret.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: il conto corrente}
\textbf{il conto corrente} — \textquotedblleft{}a bank account\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{conto corrente} is \textquotedblleft{}a running account\textquotedblright{}: \emph{conto} $\leftarrow$ Vulgar Latin \emph{contus}, \textquotedblleft{}a reckoning\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{corrente}, \textquotedblleft{}running\textquotedblright{} $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{currens}. (EtymDB 2.1)
\end{cousinweb}
